TUN.note: Names a white-zones project and a copper phase-out, not a national broadband plan with targets.

facts.fact: Tunisia's communication technologies minister told parliament on 19 November 2026 that TND 76 million from the ICT sector development fund funds a contract with Tunisie Telecom to extend coverage to white zones outside the operators' licence obligations, with contractors having started works but no sites counted.

TUN.note: Document states nothing on local government office connections.
